experiments.note: Frozen Dynamic Degree experiment. Includes persisted original construction records and derived videos where produced. Training-time on-the-fly augmentations are represented by construction protocol/selection records, not invented serialized videos. Feature caches and trained/frozen model weights are excluded; This historical archive excludes all model weights. The current user-authorized aligned-v1 head and paired backbone, plus six semantic adapters, are published separately in xju-arlab/vbench-model; older candidate heads are not part of the selected release. Validity flags, excluded sources and historical negative results remain unchanged.
